rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"

        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))

        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"

        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

    )
)

        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
    or (
        (
            starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
            or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        )
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
    or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
    or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")

        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
)

rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)

rules.description: ACFCM - Block WordPress exploit probes
rules.expression:
not cf.client.bot and (
    (
        (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-admin/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/")
        and not starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/")
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/index.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-login.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-cron.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/xmlrpc.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-comments-post.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-signup.php"
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) ne "/wp-activate.php"
    )
        or (
        (starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-content/") or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp-includes/"))
        and lower(http.request.uri.path) contains ".php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/a.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/alfa.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/wp.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/classwithtostring.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/js/index.php"
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp-admin/maint/index.php"
    )
        or (
        lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/old"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/old/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/new"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/new/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wp"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wp/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/wordpress"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/wordpress/")
        or lower(http.request.uri.path) eq "/backup"
        or starts_with(lower(http.request.uri.path), "/backup/")
    )
    )
)
